reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. You said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

The guard spent the outage logging trailer numbers by hand on a clipboard. Mateo said six trucks were waiting at the east gate by 10:44.

Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07. That makes the outage about 25 minutes from your first report.
